Simulate projected IPD with uncertainty from invasiveness estimates

simulate_projected_ipd.Rd

Scales a simulated carriage composition to n_carriage per year, splits each group over its serotypes, and multiplies by child invasiveness drawn n_reps times from its log-normal distribution. Simulated carriage is held fixed. ipd_expected is a Poisson mean, not a realised case count.

Usage

simulate_projected_ipd(
  sim,
  samodel,
  inv,
  group_lookup,
  meta_clean,
  non_typeable,
  n_reps = 1000L,
  n_carriage = 1e+05,
  seed = 1
)

Arguments

sim

A simulation from run_model() / simulate_nfds(): rows = groups, columns year.1 ... year.n.

samodel

The model structure the simulation was run with.

inv

Invasiveness lookup, e.g. from build_invasiveness_lookup().

group_lookup

Group definitions, e.g. reweight_carriage()$group_lookup.

meta_clean

Cleaned metadata, e.g. from clean_metadata().

non_typeable

Serotype labels with zero invasiveness.

n_reps

Number of Monte Carlo draws.

n_carriage

Simulated carriage population per year.

seed

Random seed, set at the start as in the original script.

Value

A list with ipd_summary, ipd_yearly, ipd_yearly_draws and ipd_serotype_summary.
